business.name: Bonham Discount Tire and Auto
business.tagline: The shop your neighbor told you about.
business.description: New and used tires, brakes, A/C and engine work — foreign and domestic. You hear the price before we touch the vehicle, and most of it goes out the same day.

services.name: Tires & wheels
services.detail: New and used tires, custom wheels, mounting and balancing.

services.name: Brakes & safety
services.detail: Pads, rotors, calipers and full brake inspections.

services.name: Engine & performance
services.detail: Diagnostics through engine work, foreign and domestic.

services.name: Oil & fluid service
services.detail: Conventional through full synthetic, filters and fluids.

services.name: A/C & heating
services.detail: Recharge, leak diagnosis and component replacement.

services.name: Cooling system
services.detail: Radiators, water pumps, thermostats and hoses.

services.name: Suspension & steering
services.detail: Struts, shocks, control arms and alignments.

services.name: Electrical & starting
services.detail: Batteries, starters, alternators and wiring faults.

services.name: Trucks & off-road
services.detail: Lift kits, oversized tires and truck-specific work.

coverage.heading: You know where to find us
coverage.summary: Same building on N Center St, six days a week. Drivers come to us from Honey Grove, Ector, Savoy and out past Trenton — because it's worth the drive to deal with people who tell you the truth about your car.
coverage.note: Walk in, call ahead, or just pull into the lot. We'll take a look.

process.title: Pull in or call ahead
process.detail: Walk-ins are fine. Tell us what it's doing — the noise, the light, the pull to one side — and we'll get eyes on it.

process.title: You hear the number first
process.detail: We find the actual problem, then quote it. Nothing gets touched until you say go, and nothing gets added without a phone call.

process.title: Usually out the same day
process.detail: Tires, brakes and routine work rarely need overnight. If it's bigger, you'll know that up front too.

trustPoints.title: Tires at every price point
trustPoints.detail: New when you want them, good used when the budget says otherwise. We'll tell you honestly which one your car needs.

trustPoints.title: Foreign and domestic
trustPoints.detail: One shop for the whole driveway — the work truck, the commuter, and the kid's first car.

trustPoints.title: Credit isn't the gate
trustPoints.detail: Acima and Snap Finance. A bald tire is a safety problem, not a credit decision.

trustPoints.title: Quoted before we start
trustPoints.detail: You approve a number first. No mystery line items when you come to pay.

trustPoints.title: 4.8 from 68 neighbors
trustPoints.detail: Fannin County drivers who came back a second time and said so publicly.

trustPoints.title: We're not going anywhere
trustPoints.detail: Same building, same people. If something isn't right, you know exactly where to find us.

callout.title: Credit shouldn't decide whether you drive safely
callout.body: Acima and Snap Finance approve regardless of credit history. Get the tires or the repair now, pay it out over time — because worn brakes don't wait for payday.

cta.title: Something not right with it?
cta.body: Bring it by or call and describe it. We'll tell you what's actually wrong and what it costs before you commit to anything.

headings.process: Three visits' worth of trust, in one
